verse.verse_1: Say: 'It is revealed to me that a party of jinn listened then said: "We have indeed heard a wonderful Koran,
verse.verse_2: that guides to the Right Path. We believe in it and we will not associate anyone with our Lord.
verse.verse_3: He exalted be the Majesty of our Lord, who has neither taken to Himself a wife, nor a son!
verse.verse_4: The ignorant fool among us has spoken outrageously against Allah,
verse.verse_5: we never thought that either human or jinn would ever tell a lie against Allah!'
verse.verse_6: But there were certain men from mankind who would take refuge with certain males from the jinn and they increased them in tyranny.
verse.verse_7: Like you, they thought that Allah would never raise the dead.
verse.verse_8: (The jinn continued saying): "We made our way towards heaven, but we found it filled with stern guards and a flame.
verse.verse_9: There, we would sit to eavesdrop, but now an eavesdropper finds a flame in wait for him.
verse.verse_10: And so we do not know whether evil is intended for those on earth, or whether their Lord intends to guide them.
verse.verse_11: Some of us are righteous, but some are otherwise, we are sects that differ.
verse.verse_12: We know that we cannot frustrate Allah in the earth, nor can we frustrate Him by flight.
verse.verse_13: When we heard the Guidance, we believed in it, and whosoever believes in his Lord shall fear neither shortage nor injustice.
verse.verse_14: Some of us have surrendered (Muslims) and some of us have deviated. Those who surrendered sought the Right Path,
verse.verse_15: but those who have deviated shall become the fuel of Gehenna (Hell).
verse.verse_16: If they had followed the Path We would give to them abundant water to drink,
verse.verse_17: and tested them with it. And whosoever turns away from his Lord's Remembrance, He will hurl him into a stern punishment.
verse.verse_18: Mosques belong to Allah, so do not call to anyone else, other than Allah.
verse.verse_19: When the worshiper of Allah stood supplicating to Him, they swarmed around him (Prophet Muhammad).
verse.verse_20: Say: 'I supplicate only to my Lord and I do not associate any with Him'
verse.verse_21: Say: 'Indeed, I possess no power over you, either for harm or for guidance'
verse.verse_22: Say: 'None shall protect me from Allah, and other than Him, I will find no refuge,
verse.verse_23: except a deliverance from Allah and His Messages. He who disobeys Allah and His Messenger, for him is the Fire of Gehenna, which he will be in for ever.
verse.verse_24: When they see that which they were promised they shall know who is weaker in helpers and fewer in numbers.
verse.verse_25: Say: 'I do not know whether that which you are promised is near, or whether my Lord will set for it a time.
verse.verse_26: He is the Knower of the Unseen and does not disclose His Unseen to anyone,
verse.verse_27: except only to a Messenger that He has chosen, and He sends guardians before him and behind him,
verse.verse_28: so that He may know that they have delivered the Messages of their Lord and He encompasses all that is with them, and He has counted everything innumbers'
